fields.description: Issue includes prominent local reporting on a municipal court subpoena involving Bill Frey and alleged distribution of marble boards and other gambling devices in Miami, and extensive coverage of the disappearance of George F. McCall, Clerk of Criminal Court, including discussion of an office shortage and his business interests. Additional content includes editorials and business messaging supporting NRA principles, commentary on Miami tourism and race tracks, sports columns (boxing and other sports), and local columns and advertisements.
